column1: # The sharp UI texture pack (docs/mods.md): the textures botw_texpack.py builds by default, with their scale and model.
# key<TAB>value<TAB>name. The key is the pack key the game's harvest writes (a hash of the texture's stored bytes, its size and NVN
# format); no picture is kept here. The value is as in overrides.tsv (a scale, and a model where it is not the class default); the name
# is the game's texture name, for people only. These textures have the same keys in 1.9.0 and 1.6.0.
# Left out on purpose, so the game's own texture draws: title art and logos, world-map tiles and item icons (an HD texture pack covers
# them), button prompts and controller pictures (botw_prompts.py), and the soft glows and shadows that stay blurry.
